title: Rumsey Hall
summary: Clarifying that he attended Rumsey Hall in Connecticut at about 11, where there was no band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I remember how strong they were. According to the Chilton book, you -- what is this Rumsey Academy?
Oh, that was very early. I went there one year. That was up in Connecticut. That was sometime -- I would say that was between Burkley Irving and Riverdale.
So that you would have been maybe 11 or 12 or something, maybe 11.
It says here you played in the school band, which you left for almost a year, to play for almost a year with Frank Weingard. But that's not right.
No, that's not right, because I was very young when I went to Rumsey Hall and they didn't have a band, although I did have a saxophone, I remember that.
It was Rumsey Hall, not Rumsey Academy?
